claims.statement: The Northgate Business Park lease premises cover approximately 92,000 rentable square feet across Building A, Suites 100–450, along with 220 surface parking spaces and non-exclusive use of a shared loading area.

citations.quote: The premises consist of approximately 92,000 rentable square feet across Building A, Suites 100–450, together with 220 surface parking spaces and non-exclusive use of the shared loading area on the east side of the property.
